prior_importants.description: Gate pipeline diagram routes a taken ADR number to "Rejected: re-steered; blocked after 2", but decision 146 makes it a refusal: no rejection counted, nothing steered.
Guide says `pup launch` and `pup kill` refuse everyone but the operator; the source lets the conductor launch and plain-kill, refusing it only `kill --respawn`.

findings.description: "Review rounds" says round 2 is the last and leftovers become follow-up tickets (174, 90), with no condition attached. ADR 0174 L32-36 applies that only once the decision-178 setting is on; until then decisions 90 and 151 govern. The section also leaves out the never-deferred Security/Data Protection high. Add the condition, or link 0174 without restating it.

process_issues.description: Re-ask on the head round 1 already reviewed (d1d1f9d5). Both prior importants (the ADR 146 refusal routing in gate-and-debt.md, and the launch/kill tier in concepts.md/commands.md) are unchanged, so they stay unresolved. Spawned docs and conventions only, aimed at the pages round 1 left unread, because the PR is markdown-only. Skipped correctness, security, context, simplicity, guards and maintainability (no code changed), workflow-safety (no workflow change) and spec (no spec source). Skipped the consolidator because there was only one finding.

The docs reviewer checked best-practices.md, troubleshooting.md, docs/guide/README.md, README.md, `merge --approved-by` and the `land` flags, and found nothing wrong. It ran out of budget before reading getting-started.md or configuration.md. It also did not verify these best-practices.md items: the measured figures (78%, 80%, 23%, 8.6M tokens, ~84 USD, 38% of 3,218 turns), the 'at most 40' kickoff file cap (no match in src/core/*kickoff*.ts), and the 'four lines' and '12 lines' claims.
Glob returned only 100 of the 198 ADR files, so the conventions reviewer checked only a subset of the cited decision numbers.
